Explain CALMS and the Three Ways and map practices to them
Name DORA's five current software delivery metrics, their groups and the 2023/2024 changes
Calculate the five metrics from a deployment log using explicit counting rules, medians and nearest-rank percentiles
Explain how DevOps changes change approval, release planning, risk and reporting for project managers
Recognise contexts where DevOps practices are constrained and common adoption mistakes

formulas.formula: Deployment frequency = production deployments ÷ length of period
formulas.variables: deployments (count); period in weeks or working days

formulas.formula: Change lead time median and 85th percentile (nearest rank = value at rank ceil(0.85 × n))
formulas.variables: lead time in elapsed clock hours from commit to production; n = 20

formulas.formula: Change fail rate = failed deployments ÷ total deployments × 100
Deployment rework rate = unplanned deployments caused by production incidents ÷ total deployments × 100
Failed deployment recovery time: median of recovery durations
formulas.variables: minutes from detection to service restored

formula_verification_script:
import math, statistics as st
lt=[3,4,5,6,6,8,9,20,22,24,26,27,30,46,50,52,70,72,75,120]  # change lead time, elapsed hours, one change per deployment
n=len(lt); s=sorted(lt)
print("n deployments",n,"sum",sum(lt),"mean h",round(st.mean(lt),2),"median h",st.median(lt))
for p in (50,85):
    r=math.ceil(p/100*n); print(f"P{p} nearest rank r={r} ->",s[r-1])
print("share <=24h",sum(x<=24 for x in lt)/n, "share >48h", sum(x>48 for x in lt)/n)
weeks=4; wd=20
print("deploy freq per week",n/weeks,"per working day",n/wd)
fails=3; print("change fail rate %",fails/n*100)
rework=2; print("deployment rework rate %",rework/n*100)
rec=[35,50,240]; print("recovery median min",st.median(rec),"mean min",round(st.mean(rec),1), "mean h", round(st.mean(rec)/60,2))
# after improvement scenario? none
formula_verification_output: n deployments 20 sum 675 mean h 33.75 median h 25.0; P50 nearest rank r=10 -> 24; P85 nearest rank r=17 -> 70; share <=24h 0.5 share >48h 0.3; deploy freq per week 5.0 per working day 1.0; change fail rate % 15.0; deployment rework rate % 10.0; recovery median min 50 mean min 108.3
